questions.question: Describe how you have used Collibra to establish or improve a business glossary, data catalog, data dictionary, or lineage capability. How did you drive adoption among business and technical users?
In your Data Quality Analyst role, how did you use SQL in BigQuery to validate data pipeline outputs and identify source-to-target transformation issues?
Walk me through a data-quality anomaly you identified at OneMain Financial. What business rule did you define, how did you investigate root cause, and how was remediation tracked?

This role requires ensuring data use complies with governance, access-management, and control policies. How have you incorporated compliance or governance requirements into data-quality rules, remediation processes, or reporting?
How would you approach learning an unfamiliar banking data domain and its related data assets before beginning analysis for a regulatory or business request?

Describe your experience partnering with nontechnical business owners, data stewards, engineers, and technology teams to gather requirements and translate them into SQL-based data-quality checks or analytical deliverables.

What was your approach to user acceptance testing and regression testing for BigQuery data products? Please include how you developed test cases, executed SQL scripts, documented defects, and communicated results.
Give an example of a dashboard metric, KPI, or key data element whose quality you evaluated. Which dimensions of data quality did you assess, and how did you communicate the findings to stakeholders?

This position uses SQL and SAS. Your resume highlights SQL and BigQuery; what experience do you have with SAS, and how would you ramp up quickly to support SAS-based analysis or existing production processes?

Describe a situation in which competing stakeholder requests, changing priorities, or ambiguity affected a data-governance or data-quality initiative. How did you prioritize work and keep partners informed?
